_about: LTEC's standard cases, added to a new deal by scripts/add_standard_cases.py. Each is a 'derived' case built from the deal's sponsor case. exit_cap_spread is added to the sponsor case's exit cap; deal_overrides_if_below_noi applies only when the deal has below-NOI income (e.g. a TIF rebate). These are starting points: tune each deal's cases to its own diligence and give them sources.

base.label: Adjusted Base
base.note: Sponsor's operations 1% lower on rents and 3% higher on expenses; exit cap 0.25% above the sponsor's.

downside.label: Downside
downside.note: Rents 3% below the sponsor's path; other income +2%/yr; expenses 5% higher, growing 3.5%; exit cap 0.65% above the sponsor's.

stress.label: Stress
stress.note: No growth beyond 1%/yr from the sponsor's Year 1, rents 2% lower; other income 5% lower and flat; expenses 7% higher, growing 4%; exit cap 1.15% above the sponsor's.
